propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are incorrectly housed in fsck_repair.py despite being unrelated to repair logic and having no structural reason to be there.

Seven production modules depend on fsck_repair.py solely to access these three primitives, creating an inverted dependency where a store-layer module (gitutil) depends on a command-layer repair module.
The three primitives must be moved to src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py as the appropriate stdlib-only leaf location, with all consumers repointed to import from gitutil instead.

Compatibility surfaces must be preserved: fsck.py continues re-exporting _ticket_dirs and _resolve_tracker_git_dir, and fsck_repair.py maintains module-level bindings for all three to support existing test patches without requiring test file edits.
